questions.question: Write 2 kg 300 g and 2 kg 30 g in grams and explain the difference.
questions.expected_answer: 2 kg 300 g is 2 000 g plus 300 g, which is 2 300 g. 2 kg 30 g is 2 000 g plus 30 g, which is 2 030 g. The 30 g fills only the tens and units places, so the hundreds digit is 0.

questions.question: Explain how to find three quarters of a kilogram in grams.
questions.expected_answer: A kilogram is 1 000 g. One quarter is 1 000 divided by 4, which is 250 g. Three quarters is 3 times 250 g, which is 750 g.

questions.question: Gogo has a 5 kg bag of flour and uses 1 kg 200 g. How much is left? Show how to check.
questions.expected_answer: 5 kg is 5 000 g and 1 kg 200 g is 1 200 g. 5 000 minus 1 200 is 3 800 g, which is 3 kg 800 g. Check: 3 800 plus 1 200 is 5 000 g.
